why: Ground truth for the log of the same name, so tests assert against a manifest rather than against literals typed into a test file - the same rule tests/fixtures/_generated/*/manifest.json follows. A log with no .expected.json beside it still gets the generic tests (it parses, patterns fire, nothing crashes); this file is what buys exact assertions.
covers: the branch where a log holds exactly ONE recording, so select_recording can pick it with no clock and no output path
note_on_first_span: No scene switch happens before recording starts, so there is no scene in force at t=0 and the first span begins at 12.5s. A parser that back-filled t=0 here would be inventing history.
